source: the business-screen floor in interface-clarity.md, What a business screen always has: an empty, loading, error or success state an application screen does not show and its UI contract records no reason to leave out; or a state the screen contract declares and the screen does not show
Nielsen usability heuristic 3, user control and freedom: a user in a nested view needs a marked way out
the screen contract's declared screen set: two declared screens whose captures are byte-identical are one screen, so one of them was never rendered
the screen contract's route: a route the contract declares and the capture could not reach
